name: BO-LT5
description: BO-LT5 was an R5-series astromech droid that was active during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Like all R-series astromech droids BO-LT5 was built by Industrial Automaton, and like all other R5 units, the droid stood 0.96 meters tall. BO-LT5's body plating was red and white in color, while its head was colored brown. During the war, BO-TL5 was offered for sale by the vendor droid 80-T5, who worked selling a range of goods from a small stall within the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant. At the time it was offered for sale, the astromech's head was decorated with a depiction of a mouth full of teeth.
